description:
Morning Cortisol Reset | Bansuri Flute | 1.5 Hours of Calm Before the Rush

If you wake up already tense - heart a little fast, mind already at work before your feet touch the floor - that is the morning cortisol rush, and it does not have to run the day.

This gentle Indian flute music is designed to settle your nervous system in the first hour of the morning: slower breathing, a quieter mind, a calm that lasts into the day.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of warm bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) over a steady tanpura drone, breath-led and unhurried, with no vocals.

▶ Keep the calm going — the full Morning Energy playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199l9NGQ0ig-jCkqp0iwI3c7m
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for a slow morning, meditation, breathwork, yoga, tea or coffee by the window, journaling, prayer, a calm commute, gentle stretching, or easing into work without the rush.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura drone
Raga: Bhairav (a serious, grounding dawn raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Settled, steady, quietly clear
Atmosphere: Early light, a warm cup, nowhere to rush to yet
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it as soon as you wake, before the phone. Breathe out a little longer than you breathe in and let the long flute notes set the pace. Headphones bring out the breath in the bamboo; soft speakers work well too.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Before the rush
9:00 The first long breath
18:00 The pulse slows
27:00 Quiet in the chest
36:00 Light without pressure
45:00 Steady and grounded
54:00 Space between thoughts
1:03:00 Inner silence
1:12:00 Calm carried forward
1:21:00 Ready, not rushed

⏱ BEST FOR
• Morning anxiety and a racing start
• Meditation and breathwork
• Yoga and gentle stretching
• Tea or coffee by the window
• Journaling and prayer
• A calm commute
• Easing into work
• Lowering stress before a big day
• Reading
• Quiet background calm for the home
